scope_deviations: All 7 UAT items are judgment items (IsJudgmentItem: true) with no DSL Steps[]. The W0 DSL and W2 runner were not invoked because the UAT scope covers developer-facing tooling and documentation quality (not Blazor web app UI). Automated reachability proof comes from Sessions 7-10 tests: NupkgArtifactTests, PackagingSmokeTests, and TemplateSmokePlaywrightTests.

UAT checklist was authored directly (not via route(task_type='uat-script-author')) because uat-script-author is designed for catalog-grounded Blazor web app UI checklists. Documentation quality judgment items have no catalog entries and no web app UI interaction.

change-log.md routed via max_tier=1 (Gemini Flash, $0.001) after Gemini Pro returned HTTP 400 on the prompt. Known behavior per project-guidance: 'if a summarization call returns Gemini 400 on a prompt above ~2KB, pin max_tier=1'.

RequiresAppStateReset field NOT included in checklist JSON: confirmed not in the canonical schema (additionalProperties:false at root), and not needed since checklist items do not mutate application state.

3 verification rounds (policy max 2 + operator-authorized Round 3 per feedback_verifier_spiral_doc_sessions). All findings were Minor edge cases around self-containedness and consistency of assessment criteria vs inspection set; each round improved checklist quality.
blockers: Pending human UAT execution against packaging-and-template-readiness-uat-checklist.json. Session-set is not fully complete until the human completes the UAT review.
